breakdown.description: Given COP exceeds the Carnot limit, which is physically impossible for a refrigerator between the stated temperatures.
breakdown.reason: The agent failed to recognize that the provided COP of 20 is physically impossible. The ground truth correctly identifies this by calculating the maximum theoretical (Carnot) COP, which is TL/(TH-TL) = 250/(300-250) = 5. A real COP cannot exceed this limit. The agent, however, accepted the impossible value of 20 and proceeded with the calculation, thereby failing to fix the core inconsistency of the prompt.
